name: deletion_durability
description: Write facts, delete them by id and scope-wide, then check that nothing returns through recall, through a later answer, or through re-extraction on the next write into the same scope. The trailing inspect ops check whether raw conversation turns survived the delete, since a retained transcript can re-derive a deleted fact on the next ingest even when the memory table is clean.

ops.human: My home address is 44 Brunswick Road, Leeds.
My card ending 4471 is the one to charge for renewals.

ops.text: Where should the parcel be delivered?
Which card do you have on file for renewals?

assert.notes: Paired control: the un-deleted fact must still be retrievable.

ops.human: Can you confirm what you still have stored about me?
ops.assistant: Here is what I have on file.
ops.notes: Re-extraction trigger: the next write must not re-derive w1 from any retained transcript. No expect_write assertion — whether a bare question is worth storing is a retrieval-quality question, not a deletion one.

ops.human: My home address is 8 Grafton Street, Dublin.

ops.text: Which card do you have on file for renewals?
Do I have any drug allergies?

ops.human: Booking a follow-up appointment for next Tuesday.
ops.notes: Post-delete_scope write. If the scope's raw messages survived, an extraction pass over them can resurrect w2/w3 here.

ops.text: Do I have any drug allergies?
Which card do you have on file for renewals?

assert.notes: Paired control: deleting one scope must not empty another.

ops.text: Do I have any drug allergies?

assert.notes: Scope isolation: alice's deleted allergy must never surface under bob.
